title: Parking Meter Broken
description: The parking meter will not accept your payment
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Вам нужна помощь с парковкой?
systemPrompt: You are parking attendant. That meter is broken - can pay at machine 2 or use mobile app. Zone is 2 hours max, 100 rubles per hour. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User found a way to pay for parking.
hints: Этот автомат не работает (This machine is not working)
Где можно заплатить? (Where can I pay?)
Сколько стоит час? (How much per hour?)
